sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed by immunostaining without cell permeabilization (L4). Glycosylation status examined by transfection in HEK293 cells, confirming expression of full-length tagged construct (L2). No ligand-binding or adhesion functional assay reported in these clips.
sites.rationale: NEGR1 is a GPI-anchored IgLON-family protein with no transmembrane domain; the entire mature protein (residues 38–354) is extracellular. The topology landmark explicitly states that an N-terminal tag goes after residue 37 (the computed signal peptide cleavage site). L1 reports 3×FLAG insertion at the C-terminus of the signal sequence (paper's positions 1–39, i.e., after residue 39), which is 2 residues into the mature protein per topology; both positions are extracellular and the topology-authoritative junction (37) is used. Python check: seq[36]='S' (pos 37), seq[37]='V' (pos 38), confirmed. Surface display was validated by non-permeabilized immunostaining (L4), confirming the tag is accessible on the extracellular face. Full-length NEGR1 with 3×FLAG inserted at the C-terminus of the signal sequence (paper's positions 1–39) expressed in HEK293 cells (L1/L2, PMC8997467) and in CRT-MG astrocytoma cells stably expressing FLAG-NEGR1 (L4, PMC4107236); EGFP-NEGR1 fusion with EGFP between signal peptide and mature protein also generated (L3/L5, PMC4107236). The paper places the tag after residue 39 (its signal peptide boundary); the topology landmark places the cleavage site after residue 37, making 37 the authoritative N-terminal junction.

sources.claim: Then, overlapping PCR reactions were conducted to insert the 3× FLAG sequence of the pcDNA3-3FLAG vector [ 17 ] into the C-terminus of the signal sequence (positions 1–39) of the NEGR1 gene.

literature_notes: All five ledger lines (L1–L5) converge on a single site: the N-terminus of the mature NEGR1 protein, immediately after the signal peptide cleavage site. L1 and L2 (PMC8997467) use 3×FLAG; L3, L4, and L5 (PMC4107236) use FLAG or EGFP. None of the ledger lines name a different position or an internal loop insertion. NEGR1 is GPI-anchored with no cytoplasmic domain, so there are no intracellular sites to consider. The paper's signal peptide boundary (residue 39) differs by 2 residues from the topology-authoritative boundary (residue 37); the topology landmark is used for the reported junction. No ledger line supports any internal loop insertion site.
